name: Knight Scholars Program
what_you_do: High school students explore cancer research and care careers. First comes a 1 week intro at OHSU. Then 10 week programs mix lab or shadowing time with work in their home communities.
who_can_apply: Oregon high school students. OHSU especially wants students from underserved and rural communities. Students at any Oregon high school may apply. Ages and grades are not stated. Students must meet health care worker shot rules.
pay_detail: Scholars are paid a stipend (amount not stated). OHSU also pays for hotel or residence hall housing during time in Portland.
duration: Introduction 1 week; Immersion 10 weeks; Intensive 10 weeks (each level requires finishing the one before)
deadline_text: The page says there is no summer program in 2026 and to check back in the fall of 2026.
how_to_apply: Send in a form. Also send a recommendation from a teacher, counselor, principal, adviser, coach or other teacher. If you have a question, you can send an email to knightscholars@ohsu.edu.
notes: Applications were closed when the page was read. Confirm whether a 2027 group is running before you plan around it. Oregon BOLI does not give work permits to minors ages 14 to 17. Employers need a certificate to hire minors.
